tools.name: screen_record
tools.description: Ask the user to record a browser-selected screen, window or tab and import the real take into this project's existing Media library as an edit of this turn. Always shows a recording card; even Auto requires a user click and the browser's display picker. source is only a suggestion, never a selected device. Optional microphone requires user permission. No Argent, host device bridge, silent recording, automatic app control or automatic timeline placement. A declined or timed-out request must not be repeated in this turn. Reuse a returned job to finish importing an already uploaded take; never record again just because project validation or saving failed.
